scene1: Your name is Titako Nakama, you are a master of the ancient Jankenpon martial arts.
Your life is peaceful and you spend your days in your sewer dojo.
You have taught many rodents in this temple but none of them were able to graduate.
Their remains might help your diet (you practice recycling),
but it still shames you to teach these idiots
It's time to look for talent in a different place, maybe a scrapyard
scene2: You gather up all you need for your trip and begin saying goodbye to your home
Looking over your dojo for the last time you relive all the memories,
days oversseing your apprentices, afternoons with Jeferson your pet bull,
in your last look over your home you see, from the corner of your eye, your pipe.
"almost forgot" you say, extending a hand.
before putting it in your plastic bag you take a look inside
and realize there's some leftover from the last time you smoked
For the last time in this place you open your lighter and start listening to the pops
scene3: Some minutes later you wake up and with tears in your face you climb manhole ladder for the last time.
You wipe the tears from your face while your eyes adjust to the daylight, an in this moment you see them.
The antichrist, {numEnemies} of them, staring at you with disgust in their eyes.
"I HATE THE ANTICHRIST", you scream as your bag hits the ground
they aproach while you ready yourself for the greatest battle of your life
